references.text: Here the Sadducees are mentioned, who are also noted in Mark 12:18 in connection with their question about the resurrection.
This passage in Matthew parallels the event in Mark 12:18, where the Sadducees ask Jesus about the resurrection.
Luke gives a similar account to Mark 12:18 regarding the Sadducees' question to Jesus concerning the resurrection.
This verse in Psalms suggests a belief that there is no activity or knowledge in the realm of the dead, which may relate to the Sadducees' belief mentioned in Mark 12:18.
